top.title: Jemperli (dostarlimab) Approved in the U.S. as First and Only Immunotherapy for Adults with MSI-H/dMMR Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
top.summary: GSK received FDA approval for Jemperli (dostarlimab) as the first immunotherapy for adults with stage II and III MSI-H/dMMR locally advanced rectal cancer. The AZUR-1 trial showed 68% of patients achieved sustained clinical complete responses at 12 months without surgery, with no disease recurrences reported among responders after median follow-up of over 2 years. The approval could help eligible patients avoid chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery.

top.title: Robbins LLP Urges ARDX Stockholders to Contact the Firm for Information About the Securities Class Action Against Ardelyx, Inc.
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Ardelyx, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARDX) alleging the company misled investors about its commercial performance and growth prospects for its drug products IBSRELA and XPHOZAH. The lawsuit covers purchases between January 13, 2025 and August 6, 2026. On August 6, 2026, Ardelyx reduced its full-year 2026 IBSRELA revenue guidance and withdrew long-term XPHOZAH guidance due to increased payer access barriers, causing the stock to drop 18% in one day from $4.87 to $4.00 per share.
